title: Has anyone tried this HK online store for strollers?
label: gear

posts.body:
I'm in the market for strollers right now and stumbled into this site: www.mobe.hk

It's apparently a hong kong based online stroller store. The prices seem pretty good but there's not much information on the website so I'm a bit worried it's a scam. Has anyone tried it? Any feedback on the company?

Thanks!

posts.body:
Couple red flags - there doesn't seem to be a phone number to contact them anywhere on their site - so if you have a problem with your product dealing with a refund or exchange may be difficult. 

 They also have a pretty poor refund policy if THEY fail to deliver goods - which can tie up your cash for up to a month.... "If we cannot deliver the goods you have ordered, we will notify you within 24 hours. The value of the undelivered goods will be refunded to your credit card account within 30 days." That alone would turn me off.

posts.body:
i was tempted to order a peg perego from mobe.hk due to the huge discount but was abit skeptical about the lack of company information given (despite sending them an email). They have only disclosed that the warranty will be cover by a company licensed in US with no further details provided, that itself sounds rather dodgy to me. 

So we decided not to save a couple of hundreds and worry bout the after purchase customer services. =)

posts.body:
I don't think this website is cheap honestly, as I looked at it a few times for different prams/ strollers; when I compared the price to Amazon.com, I realize they're not cheaper than local stores; (mobe ship from US anyways and they take long time same as Amazon)

When I compare the price to local suppliers, it's not cheaper either. Rather buy directly myself from Amazon or local retailers (especial some stores offers generous discount if you have membership)
